title: 理想比子环多一个吸收条件
An ideal also absorbs multiplication
entries.tex: a,b\in I\Rightarrow a-b\in I,\quad r\in R,\ a\in I\Rightarrow ra,ar\in I
text: 理想是非空子集，对差封闭，并吸收来自整个 R 的左右乘法。所有理想都是子环，子环未必是理想。真理想还要求 I≠R。
An ideal is a nonempty subset closed under differences and multiplication on either side by arbitrary ring elements. Every ideal is a subring, but not conversely. A proper ideal must differ from R.
example: ℤ 是 ℚ 的子环却不是理想，因为 (1/2)·1∉ℤ。dℤ 都是 ℤ 的理想；有单位元的环中，含 1 的理想必为整个环。
ℤ is a subring of ℚ but not an ideal, since (1/2)·1∉ℤ. Every dℤ is an ideal of ℤ. In a unital ring an ideal containing 1 is the whole ring.

title: 理想的和与交
Sums and intersections of ideals
text: 有限个理想的和、任意非空族理想的交仍是理想。I+J 是同时包含 I 和 J 的最小理想，通常不能用并集 I∪J 代替。
Finite sums and intersections of any nonempty family of ideals are ideals. I+J is the smallest ideal containing both I and J; the union generally does not work.
proof: 0∈I+J；两元素之差可按 I、J 分量相减。对任意 r∈R，r(a+b)=ra+rb、(a+b)r=ar+br，仍属于 I+J。
Zero lies in I+J. Differences and left or right products remain in the sum by working componentwise.
交中的元素在每个理想内，对差与左右乘法封闭，所以交是理想。
Elements in an intersection lie in every ideal, so differences and both products remain there.
任何同时包含 I、J 的理想都包含其元素的和。因此 I+J 最小；有限个理想时归纳即可。
Any ideal containing I and J contains all their sums. Induct for finitely many ideals.
example: In ℤ, (a)+(b)=(gcd(a,b)) and (a)∩(b)=(lcm(a,b)) for positive a,b.

title: 主理想：先问环有什么条件
Principal ideals depend on the ring
entries.tex: \begin{gathered}(a)=\mathbb Za+Ra+aR+RaR\\R\text{ unital}:\ (a)=RaR\\R\text{ commutative}:\\(a)=\mathbb Za+Ra\\R\text{ commutative, unital}:\\(a)=Ra\end{gathered}
text: (a) 是包含 a 的所有理想的交。式中 RaR 表示有限和 ∑rᵢasᵢ，并非只取单个乘积。只有交换且有单位元时，才可以直接写 (a)=aR。

The principal ideal (a) is the intersection of all ideals containing a. Here RaR means finite sums of products rᵢasᵢ, not single products. The familiar formula (a)=aR requires a commutative unital ring.
proof: 集合 ℤa+Ra+aR+RaR 包含 a，对加减与左右乘 R 中元素封闭，因此是包含 a 的理想。
The set ℤa+Ra+aR+RaR contains a and is closed under differences and both multiplications, hence is an ideal.
任何包含 a 的理想都必须包含这些项及其有限和，因此该集合恰为最小理想 (a)。
Any ideal containing a must contain every listed term and their finite sums, proving minimality.
有 1 时，整数倍、左乘项与右乘项可写成双侧乘积；交换时双侧项与右乘项并入 Ra。两条件同时成立时，整数倍也并入 Ra。
With 1, integer multiples and one-sided terms become two-sided products. With commutativity, all product terms lie in Ra. Both conditions reduce everything to Ra.
warning: 在 2ℤ 中，由 2 生成的理想是 2ℤ，但 2·(2ℤ)=4ℤ。这是漏掉单位元条件的最小典型。
In 2ℤ, the ideal generated by 2 is 2ℤ, while 2·(2ℤ)=4ℤ. The identity hypothesis matters.

title: 从一组生成元到一个最大公因数
Generators and a greatest common divisor
text: 由有限多个元素生成的理想是各自主理想的和。在交换有单位元的环中，它由全部有限线性组合组成。ℤ 和 ℤₙ 中每个理想都是主理想。
An ideal generated by finitely many elements is the sum of their principal ideals. In a commutative unital ring its elements are their linear combinations. Every ideal of ℤ or ℤₙ is principal.
proof: 设 d=gcd(a,b)。因 d 整除 a,b，所有 as+bt 都是 d 的倍数，所以 (a,b)⊆(d)。
Let d=gcd(a,b). Every linear combination as+bt is divisible by d, so (a,b)⊆(d).
整数 Bézout 等式给出 d=as+bt，故 d∈(a,b)，得到反向包含。a=b=0 时两边均为零理想。
Integer Bézout gives d=as+bt, proving the reverse inclusion. If a=b=0 both ideals are zero.

title: 商环：把理想中的元素视为零
Quotient rings: declare an ideal zero
text: 商环的元素是加法陪集。若 a−a′、b−b′∈I，乘积代表的选择不能影响结果；这正是理想吸收条件的作用。
Elements of a quotient ring are additive cosets. Replacing representatives must leave the product unchanged, and the absorbing property of an ideal ensures this.
proof: 加法良定义由加法商群得到。若 a−a′、b−b′∈I，则 ab−a′b′=a(b−b′)+(a−a′)b′∈I。
Addition comes from the additive quotient group. For multiplication, ab−a′b′=a(b−b′)+(a−a′)b′ lies in I.
因此两种运算均与代表无关。结合律与分配律把代表代入 R 中相应等式即得。
Both operations are independent of representatives. Associativity and distributivity descend from R.
反过来，若陪集乘法可按此式良定义，由 i+I=0+I 得 ri+I=ir+I=I，故吸收条件是必要的。
Conversely, well-defined coset multiplication forces ri and ir into I for every i∈I and r∈R.

title: 零元、单位元与交换性如何下降
What passes to the quotient?
text: 商环的零元是整个理想 I。R 若交换，则 R/I 交换；若 R 有单位元且 I 为真理想，则 1+I 是非零单位元。零因子可能在取商后出现。
The zero of R/I is the entire ideal I. Commutativity descends; if R is unital and I is proper, 1+I is a nonzero identity. Zero-divisors may appear after taking a quotient.
proof: a+I 与 I 相加仍为 a+I；由 1a=a1=a 得 (1+I)(a+I)=a+I。
Adding I leaves a+I unchanged, and multiplication by 1+I does likewise.
若 1∈I，则 r=r1∈I 对任意 r 成立，所以 I=R。故真理想保证 1+I≠I。
If 1∈I, then r=r1∈I for all r, so I=R. Properness keeps the quotient identity nonzero.
交换律从代表传下去。ℤ 是整环，但 ℤ/(6) 中 [2][3]=0，说明无零因子性不自动下降。
Commutativity descends through representatives. But ℤ/(6) has [2][3]=0 even though ℤ is a domain.

title: 棋盘着色就是一个商环
A checkerboard quotient
text: a+bi 属于 (1+i) 当且仅当 a,b 同奇偶。因此所有高斯整数分成两类；取商后 i=−1=1，所得环只有 0、1 两个元素。
A Gaussian integer a+bi lies in (1+i) exactly when a,b have the same parity. There are two cosets. In the quotient i=−1=1, leaving a ring with two elements.
proof: (1+i)(u+vi)=(u−v)+(u+v)i，所以两个坐标同奇偶。
The coordinates of (1+i)(u+vi)=(u−v)+(u+v)i have the same parity.
若 a,b 同奇偶，则 u=(a+b)/2、v=(b−a)/2 均为整数，给出所需表示。
Conversely, equal parity makes u=(a+b)/2 and v=(b−a)/2 integers.
不同奇偶的点都与 1 同陪集。因此商环恰有两元，并按模 2 运算，故同构于 𝔽₂。
The other points form 1+(1+i). Thus the quotient has exactly two elements and arithmetic modulo 2.

question: 在 ℤ 中，(6)+(10) 是哪个理想？
In ℤ, which ideal is (6)+(10)?
为什么 ℤ⊂ℚ 不是理想？
Why is ℤ not an ideal of ℚ?
reason: 理想必须吸收来自整个 ℚ 的乘法，而不仅是自身元素的乘法。
An ideal must absorb multiplication by every element of ℚ.

question: ℤ₁₂/(4) 有多少个元素？
How many elements does ℤ₁₂/(4) have?
reason: The ideal is {0,4,8}, so there are 12/3=4 cosets.

question: 在环 2ℤ 中，由 2 生成的理想是什么？
What ideal does 2 generate in the ring 2ℤ?
reason: 生成理想必须包含 2，因此是整个 2ℤ；无单位元时不能把 (2) 误写为 2R=4ℤ。
The ideal must contain 2, so is all of 2ℤ. Without an identity, (2) need not equal 2R.

question: 证明商环乘法与代表元无关，指出理想条件在哪里使用。
Prove quotient multiplication is independent of representatives and identify the ideal condition.
reason: 若 a−a′、b−b′∈I，则 ab−a′b′=a(b−b′)+(a−a′)b′。左右吸收条件保证两项都在 I，加法封闭保证和在 I，于是 ab+I=a′b′+I。
If a−a′,b−b′∈I, then ab−a′b′=a(b−b′)+(a−a′)b′. The two-sided absorbing property puts both terms in I, and additive closure puts their sum in I.
